codes.invalid_argument: An argument the tool does not declare, a value of the wrong type, a missing required argument, or a combination the tool refuses: a page number the document does not have, `cursor` together with `pages`, or a cursor passed with different options than the call that produced it. The message names the problem. For an undeclared or mistyped argument the recovery lists the arguments the tool accepts.
codes.invalid_cursor: `cursor` is not a token this tool returned, belongs to a different tool, or is more than ten minutes old. Call the tool again without a cursor.
codes.stale_cursor: The document changed between two pages of the same read, or a page the cursor resumes inside was transcribed again and its text differs. Start again without a cursor.
codes.resource_limit: The request would exceed a fixed budget: the document has more than 2,000 pages, extraction took longer than 20 seconds, too many documents are already being read, an OCR run is already in progress, too many `list_documents` calls are running, or not even part of one page fits the response. See [Limits](/docs/pdf-mcp/limits).

codes.path_outside_root: `filePath` resolves outside the folder the server was started with. Paths are relative to that folder, and `..` cannot leave it.
codes.file_not_found: No file exists at `filePath`. Call `list_documents` for the paths that do.
codes.not_a_file: `filePath` names a directory or another entry that is not a regular file.
codes.unsupported_extension: The file does not end in `.pdf`, the only extension this server reads.
codes.file_too_large: The file is over 32 MiB. Every PDF is extracted whole, so there is no mode for a larger one; split the document.
codes.file_changed: The file was modified while it was being read. Retry the call.
codes.unsupported_for_format: Not raised by this server. Every readable PDF is extracted whole, so there is no reduced mode that refuses a tool.
codes.unsupported_platform: The native package that gives the server safe file access is missing for this operating system and CPU. Reinstall on a supported platform.

codes.malformed_pdf: The file is not a readable PDF: it is truncated, or it is something else with a `.pdf` extension.
codes.encrypted_pdf: The document is password-protected. The server never asks for a password; supply an unprotected copy.
codes.extraction_failed: The PDF engine could not read a document that is otherwise a PDF, usually because it uses a feature the engine does not support. Retrying the same call does not help.

codes.ocr_unavailable: A call passed `ocr: true`, but the server was started without an OCR binding. `describe_document` reports `capabilities.ocr: false` in that case. Omit `ocr` to read the text layer alone, or start the server with `--ocr`.
codes.ocr_failed: The rasterizer or the OCR provider failed, or OCR took longer than its budget (two minutes at most). The pages keep their `needsOcr` marking; no text is invented for them.

codes.internal_error: A defect in the server, not in your document or your call. This is the one code with no `recovery`, because there is no next call that fixes it. The detail is written to the server's stderr.

keys.maxPages: Most pages a document may have; a longer one is refused before it is extracted
keys.maxExtractMs: Time one extraction may take before the call fails with `resource_limit`
keys.maxConcurrentExtractions: Documents that may be extracted at once before a new read fails with `resource_limit`
keys.documentCacheSize: Extracted documents kept in memory between calls
keys.maxListScan: Directory entries `list_documents` walks before it reports `scanTruncated`
keys.maxConcurrentListings: `list_documents` calls that may run at once

keys.maxPayloadBytes: Largest serialized answer; a longer page is clamped and continues through `nextCursor`
keys.maxReadPages: Largest `maxPages` for `read_pages`, and the most page numbers `pages` may name

keys.ocrDpi: Resolution pages are rendered at when the binding sets no `dpi`
keys.maxOcrPagesPerCall: Pages sent to the provider in one call; a binding's `maxPagesPerCall` can lower it, never raise it
keys.maxOcrMs: Time one OCR run may take; a binding's `timeoutMs` can lower it, never raise it
keys.maxConcurrentOcr: OCR runs that may be in progress at once before a new one fails with `resource_limit`
keys.ocrCacheEntries: Transcribed pages kept in memory, keyed by document content and page number

hidden.catalogTtlMs: a cache hint on the `tools/list` answer, not a limit on a call
hidden.maxFileBytes: the file layer's ceiling; `maxPdfBytes` is lower and is what this server enforces
hidden.maxStringChars: not applied by this server; a page's Markdown is bounded by `maxPayloadBytes` instead
